correctness.rationale: Writing R=u⊗phi and testing a vector in ker(phi) gives phi∘L_u=lambda phi; testing two vectors with phi value 1 gives u^2=2lambda u. A unit u would be the scalar 2lambda and then lambda=2lambda, impossible. Thus u is in J, L_u is nilpotent, and lambda vanishes. Testing the other input also gives phi(Au)=0. Conversely both ideals uA and Au are kz for u in kz and span(u,z) otherwise; u^2=0 in all characteristics. This gives exactly phi(z)=0 and a beta+b gamma=0. The separately defined reduced projectivization is the rank-two bilinear incidence hypersurface under the Segre embedding; the bilinear polynomial is geometrically irreducible. Its only singular chart point occurs at the radical entry on each side, with tangent cone the smooth split-quadric cone a beta+b gamma=0, also in characteristic two by the partial derivatives. The automorphism matrices are the full GL2 action with two arbitrary z-shears. In the z-image case the determinant rescales the constant coefficient and the special linear group is transitive on nonzero covectors. Off the socle, normalize the image to x; independent diagonal units act on the constant and remaining linear coefficient by (s,s/v). These are actions on actual tensors, not merely projective pairs. For closures, the two special sections phi=epsilon and alpha=0 are respectively a projective plane and a projective-line bundle over the covector line; each missing socle fiber is exactly as claimed. Over z the whole projective plane is the closure of its mixed open piece, and the full mixed nonsocle stratum is dense in X. Counting nonzero covectors after fixing an image-line generator gives the six cardinalities, and division by q-1 gives the projective count.
replay_paths: For a separate F2 check, encode basis monomials by masks 0,1,2,3. Products of intersecting masks are zero, otherwise multiply by mask union and add modulo 2. Test each of the 15 nonzero u and 15 nonzero phi on all sixteen ordered basis pairs via R(e)=parity(phi & e)u in the bit-vector coordinate representation. All 225 were checked, with 25 solutions, no disagreements with the incidence test, and the six type counts 3,1,3,6,6,6. The arbitrary-field proof above is needed for the geometric and transitivity conclusions.
Frozen verify.py is a candidate-side check, together with finite orbit enumeration and a symbolic Hessian check; it is not a proof that no nonincident rank-one tensor works.
residual_risks: Only the reduced scheme is classified. Closure means closure of the algebraic strata, not the closure of the finite set of rational orbit points over a finite field. The proof's switch from phi(uA)=0 to phi(Au)=0 is valid here because these ideals agree for radical u (or by testing the other input).

evidence: The earlier proof forces radical image using u^2 in ku, (c1+w)^2=c^2 1+2cw, and 1≠2, then uses nilpotence of multiplication to get phi(uA+Au)=0. The same proof gives the GL2-and-shears group and the determinant twist on the z-image case and independent diagonal rescalings off the socle. None requires characteristic two. Projectivizing the two factors gives the submitted rank-two bilinear incidence equation; its partials and the zero/nonzero conditions on the same coordinates immediately give the node and closures.

originality.rationale: The original submission claims a combined rank-one normal form, six actual orbits, counts, and projective geometry. The six real orbits and all characteristic-two finite-field orbit sizes and counts are directly covered by distinct earlier Resultary records. More decisively, the earlier characteristic-two record's actual proof of the rank-one form and the group action is characteristic-independent: it already supplies the same linear conditions, determinant-covector action and independent rescalings, not merely sampled values. The geometric observations are a correct explicit reformulation and elementary consequences after Segre projectivization, not a new rank-one equation or new conjugacy mechanism. No independently supported original central finding survives in this submitted combination.
residual_risks: Full text of the Hua–Liu 2013 possible antecedent was not retrieved, and the wider literature search is not exhaustive. The originality failure rests on positive prior overlap and implication, not that retrieval limit. No old source inspected explicitly calls the projectivization a nodal incidence threefold.

value.rationale: The natural classification and count are worthwhile questions, but the prior rank-one proof already gives their mechanism and complete invariants. The added projective census, single split bilinear node, and closure diagram are immediate geometric readings of the same rank-two equation and coordinate vanishings. As submitted they do not isolate a new nonmechanical exact invariant that would justify a separate finding.
residual_risks: The conclusion does not extend to a study of scheme structure, higher ranks, or another geometry not included in the frozen claim.
